description:
## Problem
Every scheduled medium-shard duration refresh has closed unmerged: #3927, #4003, #4065, #4089, #4284. #4476 (opened 2026-11-23 18:21Z by workflow run 45237292967, head f4f2a6ec3a) has a SHIP verdict, green required checks and merge state CLEAN, and nobody has armed it. `tests/fixtures/medium_shard_durations.json` balances the medium shards, so stale durations skew them. fast-baseline-refresh-commit-identity-owner-setting-20261120 covers only the fast-tier refresh, and the dropped fast-duration-baseline-scheduled-refresh-never-lands-20261119 covered only fast-tier review size. The scheduled run also started at 18:20Z against a 06:17Z cron.

## Change
Ask the owner who arms a scheduled refresh PR that passes review: the owner, an agent the owner names per PR, or the workflow itself. Then arm #4476 (or its successor) once under that decision and record GitHub's outcome.

## Decision gates
- An agent arms a refresh PR only when the owner names that PR and head.
- Any workflow change that arms automatically needs the owner's approval.
- No refresh commit is re-authored, amended or force-pushed.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the owner's decision is recorded; and one medium-shard refresh is merged, or its single `make pr-arm` output and final merge state are recorded.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree from `make worktree-create`; never write in the primary clone. Stage named paths only; commit as the pinned human identity with no agent attribution.
- Push only after `make pr-preflight` passes on the exact head. Never `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite authorship.
- Arm only with `make pr-arm`, once per head. A second attempt only when the refusal named a cause that is now fixed; a third needs the owner. `make pr-rerun` only for a job the runner cancelled or never ran, never to re-roll a failed test.
- Never post a stand-in review. Resolve a review thread only after the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking target. Never set `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK` or `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off`.
- Any new limit, threshold, default or user-facing label is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- Do not mark a test skip, xfail, quarantine or slow to make it pass.
- Report only what merged and what was verified, with run ids and heads.
